items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 12 June 2026 at 9:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure north of Scotland, with high pressure near Biscay gradually tracking northwards.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this evening, occasionally touching 7 in places overnight, then decreasing West or Northwest 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers for a time tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing North or Northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Sunday, becoming Variable 3 or less later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon falling smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
